Save a model to / load a model from the model store

Source: R/save-objects.R
model_store.Rd

save_model() writes a model into the content-addressed store <models_path>/<name>/ (see get_models_path()): a model.yml manifest, the thinned mod.RData, and parquet stores for the large data slots. Saving the identical content again is a no-op. The model is registered in the project registry (see load_registry()) unless registry = FALSE.

load_model() resolves a stored model by name (optionally "name@hash8", or with hash =) via the registry first, then by scanning the store directory; path bypasses resolution and loads that directory.

Usage

save_model(
  object,
  path = NULL,
  embed_repos = NULL,
  embed_datasets = NULL,
  mode = NULL,
  registry = TRUE,
  format = get_storage_format(),
  overwrite = FALSE,
  rehash = TRUE,
  verbose = TRUE
)

load_model(name, hash = NULL, path = NULL, env = NULL, verbose = TRUE)

Arguments

object

a model object.

path

character, explicit store directory (bypasses the registry).

embed_repos

NULL (default: by mode), TRUE, or FALSE. Controls whether the model's repositories are embedded in the store entry or referenced from the repository store (see save_repository()). NULL: reference a repository whose identical content is a sealed version, embed otherwise. TRUE: always embed. FALSE: require a sealed version for every repository. The model hash is always taken over the FULL model, so it is unaffected by this choice; load_model() resolves references back.

embed_datasets

the same choice one level further down, for the big data tables (weather/demand) of embedded repositories and the geoscale map on @config — see save_dataset(). NULL (default) references whatever identical content is already in the dataset store; TRUE always embeds; FALSE requires a store hit.

mode

"ref" or "full"; defaults to getOption("energyRt.save_mode", "ref"). "ref" references a repository whose exact content is a SEALED version in the repository store and copies the others in; "full" copies every repository and dataset in (a self-contained entry). An explicit embed_repos / embed_datasets overrides the mode for its level.

registry

logical, add/refresh the registry row on save.

format

storage format for the data slots (as in save_scenario()).

overwrite

logical, rewrite the store entry even when the hash matches.

rehash

logical; FALSE keeps the DESTINATION entry's recorded hash while writing the changed content — for changes the user declares insignificant (a description, a memo). The manifest marks the exception (hash_kept: true); references then verify against the retained hash. With rehash = FALSE the hash is a user-managed version tag, not a content proof.

verbose

logical.

name

character, model name, "name@hash8", or a store directory path.

hash

character, full or short content hash to pin a version.

env

environment to assign the model into by name, or NULL (default) to return it.

Value

save_model() the model, invisibly (with misc$hash / misc$path recording the store entry); load_model() the model object (or invisible(TRUE) when assigned into env).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
open_project(tempdir())

ek  <- topia$modules$electricity$R3
mod <- newModel("TOPIA", data = ek$repo,
                calendar = topia$modules$calendars$s4_h24,
                region = ek$regions,
                horizon = topia$modules$horizons$base)
mod <- setGeoscale(mod, ek$geoscale)

# writes models/<name>/ and registers this version
save_model(mod)

# read it back by name (the newest version)
mod2 <- load_model("TOPIA")

# the registry lists every stored version, each addressable by its hash
load_registry()
} # }
